ei.title: 식물 환기의 중요성과 올바른 공기 순환 방법

fullPassage: In order to prevent plants from dying, good ventilation is necessary. For transpiration, one of the plant's processes, to occur, air circulation is invaluable. Inadequate ventilation may cause pest infestations to occur and (cause) mold to grow on the soil. Ideally, place plants somewhere well ventilated where they can receive a natural breeze. If they are shut indoors while you are out create air flow with an air circulator or fan. If your living environment permits it, installing a ceiling fan is also a good idea. However don't allow plants to come in direct contact with strong winds from air conditioning or fans. The leaves and stems will get extremely dry, which is hard on plants. Instead make sure (that) plants are getting gentle breezes from various directions.

questions.passage: In order to prevent plants from ①<u>dying</u>, good ventilation is necessary. For transpiration, one of the plant's processes, to occur, air circulation is invaluable. If they are shut indoors while you are out create air flow with an air ②<u>circulator</u> or fan. If your living environment permits it, ③<u>install</u> a ceiling fan is also a good idea. However don't allow plants to come in direct contact with strong winds from air conditioning or fans. The leaves and stems will get extremely dry, which is hard on plants. Instead make sure (that) plants are getting ④<u>gentle</u> breezes from various directions.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ install → installing: 주어 자리에 동명사(installing)가 필요합니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① dying: prevent ~ from dying (동명사) 올바름.
✅ ② circulator: 명사 올바름.
❌ ③ install → installing: 주어 자리이므로 동명사 installing 필요. ← 정답
✅ ④ gentle: 형용사로 breezes 수식 올바름.

questions.passage: In order to prevent plants from dying, good ventilation is necessary. For transpiration, one of the plant's processes, to occur, air circulation is invaluable. Inadequate ventilation may cause pest infestations to occur and (cause) mold to grow on the soil. Ideally, place plants somewhere well ventilated where they can receive a natural breeze. If they are shut indoors while you are out create air flow with an air circulator or fan. If your living environment permits it, installing a ceiling fan is also a good idea. However don't allow plants to come in direct contact with strong winds from air conditioning or fans. The leaves and stems will get extremely dry, which is hard on plants. Instead make sure (that) plants are getting gentle breezes from various directions.
